description: Experimental TF3 multiplayer prototype. Probe v45 / bridge v13: prepared VPN sessions exchange builds, lines, vehicles, loans and live calendar speed. v45 preserves the native next-reachable-stop choice, fixes GUI callback data and reports line path failures. v44 fixes world-entry failure in the main GUI vehicle hooks by replacing unsupported log.info with protected stdout logging. v43 reports failed replays on both PCs, reads non-enumerable world components through alternative indexes and intercepts commands in native vehicle windows via the main GUI extension. v42 replaces industry field modules through native commands before station builds and transfers rail bridge and tunnel resource types. v41 preserves rail junctions and guards replay stages. World differences remain diagnostic; a shared save is reloaded only on explicit resync request. Both PCs need the same package. Real two-PC regression tests are still required.
name: Multiplayer Probe (dev)
summary: Logs the TF3 Lua sandbox and engine API for multiplayer research.
